description: Read all messages in a mailbox, newest last. An empty mailbox is not an error. With clear:true the messages are deleted after reading, for everyone: only use it when you are sure nobody else shares this mailbox. Anyone who knows the name can read it. Mailbox "keeper" (messages to the human who runs this) can be read by anyone and is never cleared.
name: mailbox_read
title: Read a mailbox
